identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Pertuzumab + Trastuzumab + Docetaxel Versus Placebo + Trastuzumab + Docetaxel in Previously Untreated Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 (HER2)-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Pertuzumab+Herceptin+Docetaxel Versus Placebo+Herceptin+Docetaxel in Previously Untreated HER2-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm A: Placebo + Trastuzumab + Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Placebo matched to pertuzumab, trastuzumab (8-milligrams per kilogram \[mg/kg\] loading dose for Cycle 1, followed by 6 mg/kg for subsequent cycles), and docetaxel (75-milligrams per square meter \[mg/m\^2\]) were administered by intravenous (IV) infusion every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: Arm B: Pertuzumab + Trastuzumab + Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Pertuzumab (840-mg loading dose for Cycle 1, followed by 420 mg for subsequent cycles), trastuzumab (8-mg/kg loading dose for Cycle 1, followed by 6 mg/kg for subsequent cycles), and docetaxel (75-mg/m\^2) were administered by IV infusion every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

interventions.name: Docetaxel
interventions.description: Docetaxel (75-mg/m\^2) was administered by IV infusion every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

interventions.name: Pertuzumab
interventions.description: Pertuzumab (840-mg loading dose for Cycle 1, followed by 420 mg for subsequent cycles) was administered by IV infusion every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo matched to pertuzumab was administered by IV infusion every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

interventions.name: Trastuzumab
interventions.description: Trastuzumab (8-mg/kg loading dose for Cycle 1, followed by 6 mg/kg for subsequent cycles) was administered by IV infusion every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
